title: ACHIRI — /achiri-ping: check if Achiri API is live on Hetzner (health check)
description: New async /achiri-ping command. Makes HTTP GET to http://65.108.90.178:3420/stats/health with 5s timeout. Shows: LIVE (response time + version) or DOWN (error + deploy command). Added to cmd-spielberg.ts and registered in telegram-bot.ts.
